how_to_apply: Fill up the application form in Annexure-I of the advertisement.
Attach all relevant documents, including copies of PPO, Aadhaar and PAN.
Send the application by registered post or deliver it personally to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Bhabhua.
Application must reach by 11.12.2026 till 05:00 PM.
Report for the walk-in interview at District Court, Bhabhua on 17.12.2026, New Court Building (1st floor).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kaimur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kaimur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Clerk, 1 Stenographer, 1 Peon.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kaimur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this advertisement (page 3)) and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Bhabhua, by registered post or personally, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on date of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 50% of their last drawn pay plus applicable DA and TA for Clerk, 50% of their last drawn pay plus applicable DA and TA for Stenographer, 50% of their last drawn pay plus applicable DA and TA for Peon.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Civil Court employees who retired within the last three years before the selection period. The notice does not specify an educational qualification. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired Civil Court employees may apply. Candidate declares being clear from vigilance angle at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees who retired more than three years before the period when the selection is made.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal interaction (walk-in interview). Selection on the basis of personal interaction at a walk-in interview on 17.12.2026.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual and can be terminated at any time as per the direction of the Patna High Court. Period of engagement as decided by Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna. Minimum 5 hours of work each working day; Patna High Court may modify timings.
